title: Flying mounts: F1-F3 variations
desc: Three new variations each of 824's flying horse (F1), baby dragon (F2) and real-size construct ghast (F3), in his construct textures (R2 K1 dark jade, BR1, H1, W1); each built a different way with its own flight.

takes.name: winged horse, R2 K1
takes.facts: feathered slat wings fold while galloping, then flap it up to 8.5 blocks; glides from 92

takes.name: hoop horse on a light road, W1
takes.facts: open hoop frame on a spine; gallops up a road of W1 light tiles that form under the hooves and break behind, to 9 blocks

takes.name: comet horse, H1
takes.facts: smooth tapered body; rears, launches, legs stretched fore and aft, light flakes from the hooves; swoops and banks

takes.name: round wyrmling, BR1
takes.facts: ball body, bat wings on three finger bones; hovers straight up with heavy flaps, then weaves off

takes.name: serpent hatchling, R2 K1
takes.facts: nine-link body swims through the air in an S-wave; small fast wings, frill head

takes.name: blocky glider, H1
takes.facts: voxel boxes, wide four-finger wings; a leap, two big downstrokes, a long banked glide

takes.name: ghast snug shell, R2 K1
takes.facts: real 4.5-block ghast inside a bevelled one-piece shell, round tentacle sleeves; rises 4 and drifts in a slow turn

takes.name: ghast lattice cage, W1
takes.facts: 3 x 3 window cage over the real ghast, tentacles in hoop stacks; swims forward in 5 pulses

takes.name: ghast brick strata, BR1
takes.facts: five breathing slabs, glow on all 12 edges of each, brow ledge, segmented sleeves; rises 7 and banks round a wide turn
